title: Offers, coupons, campaigns và experiments
scope_items: Database Migration 00029: Created campaigns (§10.5), coupons (§19.2), coupon_redemptions tables with workspace composite tenant keys, strict tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), check constraints, and narrow role-based grants. Added valid_from/valid_until columns to offers table.

Acceptance Target 1 (Expired offer rejected at checkout): Offers enforce strict lifecycle windows (valid_from .. valid_until) and state transitions. Any checkout referencing an expired offer or outside its validity window is rejected with ERR_OFFER_EXPIRED.

Acceptance Target 2 (Coupon races do not exceed limits): Concurrent redemptions for a coupon are serialized atomically. Redemptions strictly ceil at max_uses, returning ERR_COUPON_LIMIT_EXCEEDED / ERR_COUPON_EXPIRED on any excess redemption attempt, and transitions the coupon lifecycle state to expired.

Acceptance Target 3 (Financial impact reaches ledger): Evaluated and approved checkouts produce double-entry FinancialPosting records with exact NUMERIC(18,6) amounts (DB-H-001) linked to order_id, offer_id, and coupon_id in M19 operating ledger.
Edge Case EC-M14-001: Offer activation requires either an associated product_id or an explicit product-less declaration; otherwise activation is rejected.
Edge Case EC-M14-003: Campaign budget utilization thresholds trigger proactive warnings when spend >= 80% and over-budget manager alerts when spend >= 100%.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_ExpiredOfferRejectedAtCheckout (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm rejection with ERR_OFFER_EXPIRED.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_CouponRacesDoNotExceedLimits (Go 50-goroutine concurrent race test with -race), Vitest concurrency test, and Flutter test suite confirm strict max_uses ceiling.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_FinancialImpactReachesLedger (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm FinancialPosting creation with exact non-float amounts.
EC-M14-001 & EC-M14-003 Verified: TestECM14_001_OfferActivationRequiresProduct and TestECM14_003_CampaignBudgetThresholds pass across Go, Vitest, and Flutter.
Migration 00029 Verified: Migrator test suite (migrator_test.go) passes all 29 migrations up, status verification, and clean down transactional reversal.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, and Dart test suites.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: Vitest web test suite (32 files, 256 tests passing), svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), Vite production build (adapter-node ✔ done), and Flutter test suite (219 tests passing, flutter analyze 0 issues) all pass.
external_gates: Migration 00029 schema, composite foreign keys, RLS policies (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), and narrow grants verified via dry-run and local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.
Production checkout capture integrates with external payment gateways; monetization evaluation and ledger posting verified locally.
